More info

Weekend Non-Camping

1st release
More info
  • Secure your ticket with a £20 deposit, followed by monthly instalments - choose 'Ticketmaster Instalments' at checkout.
  • Weekend Non-Camping tickets allow daily access to the festival from 09:30am on Friday 27th, Saturday 28th and Sunday 29th August 2027.
  • Weekend Non-Camping tickets will be swapped on first-time entry for a Weekend Non-Camping Wristband for access to the Arena only. There is no readmission with a Weekend Non-Camping wristband so you cannot leave the site and re-enter the same day and will not be able to leave temporarily to access cars, or nearby shops etc. Make sure you bring everything you need with you for the whole day but please remember that bags need to be smaller than A4 size. Don’t worry, your wristband will still be valid the following day when you return so please don’t remove it until the festival is over.
  • There is no access to campsites Weekend Non-Camping Tickets and they cannot be used in conjunction with Campervan Passes, Campsite Tickets or VIP Camping Upgrades.
